_comment: Accepted production advisories for `npm run check:audit`.
Anything not listed here fails the build. Each entry needs a reason, the
advisory id it accepts, the version it was reviewed against, and an expires
date. The checker fails when the advisory id or installed version no longer
matches what npm audit reports, when an entry is past its date, and when a
listed advisory is no longer reported at all, so an exception cannot
Scope is the shipped application. The reachable set comes from
`npm ls --omit=dev`, not from `npm audit --omit=dev`: the two disagree, and
audit reported brace-expansion as a production high while it was reachable
only through eslint, stryker and electron-builder. Gating on dev tooling
would have required 12 accepted entries that buried the one finding that
